editorial_changes: Distinguished dark roasts from medium/medium-dark espresso alternatives using attributed manufacturer labels.
Attributed flavor descriptions to roasters; removed guaranteed crema/taste, microfoam, origin-count, shelf-life, caffeine superlative and price-per-pound claims.
Added format, pack weight, grind, delivered-cost and machine-manual decisions.
Separated Fellow generations; corrected Bonavita/COSORI hold, COSORI presets, OXO timer/range, Hario practical capacity.
Removed cheapest/best-value and physical accuracy, speed, taste and lifespan assurances.
Kept source and scope language short; no public correction history.
